sourceResearch: ArgumentListEvaluation.mts mutates precedingArgs/restSub native arrays with push. A restored control-frame reference does not restore the arrays' indexed storage.
captureControl already snapshots frame-local bindings and exposes controlOwnedObjects; owner selection excludes those objects.
ReactFiberThenable.trackUsedThenable pushes to trackedThenables, a guest array. It is not the native-array ownership proof.
